question: Within the verified fixed-dose sampled family, which delivery targets remain attainable after a hypothetical minimum thickness is imposed, and how do separately reoptimized transport assumptions change resource requirements?
method_scope: Deterministic postprocessing of verified existing results only. No new PDE sweep, parameter fit, continuous optimization, or inference of physical feasibility.
guards: Fail closed before scientific calculation or output if this specification or any bound input differs. Validate complete unique scenario/h/deadline coverage, numerical bracket ordering, fixed geometry/dose fields, and reconstruction of the existing set frontier.

inherited_model.density: 53893.73734328731 IEQ/mL, derived from the nominal seven straight annuli, held fixed
inherited_model.segmentation: Minimum number of segments no longer than70mm, including actual shorter remainder and the inherited end effects
inherited_model.source: Uniform volumetric production, zero incremental initial inventory, constant source maintained to30min
inherited_model.observable: Cumulative boundary delivery divided by total production through30min, eta(30min); not post-shutoff fixed-pulse recovery
inherited_model.unchanged_assumptions: No binding, degradation, convection, tissue transport, secretion feedback, or oxygen field

grid.eligibility: h>=h_min on the existing discrete grid; integer hundredths of a millimetre used for comparisons
grid.physical_status: h_min is an illustrative, unassigned biological/manufacturing constraint. No empirical limit is selected. The150um IEQ volume-reference diameter is not a universal hard cutoff. Thickness alone does not establish realizability.

worst_scenario_aggregation: For every h reconstruct point=min_s eta, lower=min_s eta_lower_estimate, upper=min_s eta_upper_estimate. Record limiting parameter combinations; ties are retained. Labels are arbitrary finite assumed scenario-set labels, with no probability or continuous uncertainty coverage.
maximum_attainable_delivery: For every h_min enumerate all eligible h. Report max_h min_s eta and numerical estimates [max_h min_s lower,max_h min_s upper]. Record the point-estimate maximizing h and any competitor whose upper overlaps its lower; do not assume monotonicity or a unique maximizing h without checking.

target_selection.pass: An eligible design qualifies only if its minimum scenario lower estimate>=target.
target_selection.minimum_area: Choose the qualifying design with smallest lateral area only if every eligible design of strictly lower area has minimum scenario upper estimate<target. Record all such exclusions. Equal-area ties are listed.
target_selection.not_attained: Every eligible design has minimum scenario upper estimate<target; equivalently maximum upper estimate<target. This is a model/grid/constraint result, not physical impossibility.
target_selection.unresolved: Any interval overlap that prevents a target or minimum-area classification is reported unresolved. No silent point-estimate decision, new solver refinement, or interpolation.
target_selection.qualification: Inherited numerical estimates with analytic tail control and floating guards are not certified enclosures. All claims remain conditional on the specified model and finite grid.

mechanism_comparison.selection: Apply the identical lower-estimate and all-lower-area-upper-exclusion rule to each single-case grid.
mechanism_comparison.resource_outputs: Selected thickness, lateral area, increase relative to original0.75mm geometry and favorable reoptimized design, pouch count, total length, remainder and active bounding footprint; next lower-area competitor and exclusion margin.
mechanism_comparison.dimensionless: Fo=D*T/h^2; Bi=P*h/D. Evaluate for each case at its selected h and at nominal h=0.75mm, with T=1800s and h in metres. Store Bi as explicit infinite for perfect outer sink. Also retain selected h/b and length/aspect-ratio descriptors; Fo and Bi alone do not remove geometry dependence.
mechanism_comparison.interpretation: Five conditional reoptimizations; area penalties are nonadditive and are not causal contributions or empirically ranked mechanisms for a real device.

verification.independent_postprocessing: Governor A independently reconstructs constrained maxima, selections and mechanism rows from bound raw map. No new transport validation is implied.
checks: 546 constraint target classifications and273 maximum-delivery rows
No h_min selection violates its constraint
Feasible sets shrink as h_min increases; maximum-delivery estimates cannot increase
An already-admissible unconstrained least-area selection is unchanged
All lower-area competitor exclusions or explicit unresolved status
Agreement with existing30min frontiers and unconstrained targets
Fo/Bi SI-unit arithmetic and explicit infinite boundary values
Input and spec mutation negative tests
verification.expected_values_policy: Reviewer values are comparison checks, never fitted targets. Discrepancies are reported and investigated.
